note: Every quotation is OLCB (lug_bib) copied by script; ', NIV' is dropped from citations as the es, fr, uk and sw editions of this book do, and the introduction’s and closing NIV references name the OLCB. Rows are measured per block.

Where OLCB differs from the NIV the author quotes, the verse is kept and the surrounding sentence carries the point (1 Thessalonians 2:7 ‘gentle’, Acts 20:27 ‘whole’, Acts 20:28 ‘yourselves’, 1 Timothy 4:16). OLCB’s own spellings are kept verbatim (Ezekiel 34:4 ‘ezirumizibbwa’, Isaiah 6:1 ‘agulumizibbwa’).

Verse consistency: Isaiah 40:11 in the-god-of-all-comfort.lg and 1 Peter 2:9 in days-of-heaven-upon-earth.lg are corrected to the contiguous OLCB text in the same PR; 1 Corinthians 15:10 is absorbed into the ratchet (this book quotes the first half of the verse, watchman-nee-a-life and divine-healing the second; all three are OLCB-verbatim).

English as printed: the John 3:16 lead-in names Paul; Chrysostom’s homily counts (89/68), Newton’s ‘eight decades’ and M’Cheyne’s conversion age are translated as written. The English splits 2 Timothy 4:3 and 1 Timothy 4:16 across paragraphs; the split is kept.
AI-translated (job #2778) by fan-out over 4 translators; tag sequence identical to the English per chapter; awaiting native review.
